question: Let $\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 3 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 4 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 \end{vmatrix}$. If $A$ is a diagonal matrix, then $|A|$ equals:
explanation:
The determinant of a diagonal matrix is the product of the diagonal elements.
So, $|A| = 3 \times 4 \times 5$.
$|A| = 60$.
